text: トレーナーに　なったばかりの　おとうとに　つきそってるの

structure.jp: トレーナーに　なったばかりの　おとうとに
structure.en: my little brother who has only just become a Trainer

patterns.name: 〜たばかり
patterns.span: なったばかりの　おとうと
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a past verb says it only just happened, and の ties that to the person it describes. なったばかりの　おとうと = 'my little brother who has only just become one'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: つきそってる is a short spoken form of つきそっている, which says the action is going on now. つきそってる = 'I am accompanying'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end shows the speaker is explaining her situation, in a soft, feminine way. つきそってるの = 'I'm accompanying him, you see'.
